subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Self-control is (i) is similar to a best (b) A self-controlled (ii) a constant control over man his thoughts his speech and his acts (c) A man devoid of (iii) who are controlled self-control minded (d) The strongest man (iv) at the root of all virtues by discipline exercises (e) Hence the Almighty (v) who are uncontrolled loves those minded (vi) does not become the slave of his strong desire
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iv) Self control is at the root of all virtures. (b) + (vi) A self controlled man does not become the slave of his strong desire. (c) + (i) A man devoid of self control is similar to a beast. (d) + (ii) The strongest man by discipline exercises a constant control over his thoughts his speech and his acts. (e) + (iii) Hence the Almighty loves those who are controlled minded.
